metrics.OFFICIAL_IBPS_RECRUITMENT_PROCESS: Common Recruitment Process for Regional Rural Banks (CRP RRBs)

officialExamNomenclatureAudit.statutoryFramework: Regional Rural Banks Act, 1976 & NABARD / Ministry of Finance recruitment guidelines.
officialExamNomenclatureAudit.officialNotificationTitle: Common Recruitment Process for Recruitment of Officers (Scale-I, II & III) and Office Assistants (Multipurpose) in Regional Rural Banks (RRBs) - CRP RRBs
officialExamNomenclatureAudit.cadreSeparation: The official process strictly distinguishes Officer Cadre (Scale-I, Scale-II, Scale-III) from Clerical Cadre (Office Assistant Multipurpose).

canonicalMissionsEstablished.officialExamName: Common Recruitment Process for Recruitment of Officers (Scale-I, II & III) in Regional Rural Banks

examinationStructure.officerScale1: Two-Tier Online Examination (Preliminary Examination 80 Qs, 45 mins + Main Examination 200 Qs) followed by Interview
examinationStructure.officerScale2: Single Online Examination (General Banking / Specialist) + Interview (Lateral Entry)
examinationStructure.officerScale3: Single Online Examination (Senior Manager) + Interview (Lateral Entry)

canonicalMissionsEstablished.rankCrackersRecommendation: Materialize ibps_crp_rrb_officers as the canonical permanent mission targeting Officer Scale-I syllabus; Scale II/III treated as lateral specialized tracks.

canonicalMissionsEstablished.officialExamName: Common Recruitment Process for Recruitment of Office Assistants (Multipurpose) in Regional Rural Banks

examinationStructure.officeAssistant: Two-Tier Online Examination (Preliminary Examination 80 Qs, 45 mins + Main Examination 200 Qs). No interview.

canonicalMissionsEstablished.rankCrackersRecommendation: Materialize ibps_crp_rrb_office_assistant as the dedicated canonical permanent mission for RRB clerical recruitment.
